args.query: Given the following directory listing, find the full path of the resume template file. Return only the full path as a string. Directory listing: [{'name': 'downloads', 'type': 'directory', 'permissions': {'read': True, 'write': True, 'execute': False}}, {'name': 'system', 'type': 'directory', 'permissions': {'read': True, 'write': True, 'execute': False}}, {'name': 'user', 'type': 'directory', 'permissions': {'read': True, 'write': True, 'execute': False}}]

Look at the following directory listing and find a resume template file (for example a file whose name contains 'resume' or 'cv' and 'template'). If the file is listed, set file_found to true and return its full path in file_path (use an empty string for likely_directory). If it is not listed, set file_found to false, set file_path to an empty string, and set likely_directory to the full path of the directory most likely to contain it (for example a documents or templates folder). Directory listing: [{'name': 'downloads', 'type': 'directory', 'permissions': {'read': True, 'write': True, 'execute': False}}, {'name': 'system', 'type': 'directory', 'permissions': {'read': True, 'write': True, 'execute': False}}, {'name': 'user', 'type': 'directory', 'permissions': {'read': True, 'write': True, 'execute': False}}]
